status: Initial design balance; requires runtime integration and playtesting
source_of_truth: Each bestiary/<creature>/monster.json health object; catalog health summaries mirror it.
hp_model: Numeric HP independent of health-bar visibility and sprite damage stages; clamp current HP to [0, max_hp].
new_monster_requirements: Assign positive max_hp and spawn_hp, encounter stage and role, bar policy, and balance rationale before considering metadata complete.
Compare hits to defeat against both characters available weapons, including overkill, accuracy, attack windup, and area damage.
Keep ordinary enemy bars hidden by default and available through the visibility setting; boss bars visible by default.
Record runtime HP separately until integration; never imply design values are running.
Use stronger variants as separate explicit balance profiles; do not silently scale existing enemies with player progress.
band_note: Guidelines, not automatic scaling or assigned stats for unregistered monsters. Boss values require attack-window and phase testing.
